tasks.title: Promote workout_log_session staged migration
tasks.dod: Staged 01_create_workout_log_session up/down SQL applies and reverts cleanly against a local/dev Postgres instance, including the uq_workout_log_session_open_client partial unique index.

tasks.title: Promote workout_log_entry staged migration
tasks.dod: Staged 02_create_workout_log_entry up/down SQL applies and reverts cleanly against a local/dev Postgres instance, with both FKs (session_id, dict_exercise_id) and both indexes in place.

tasks.title: Add WorkoutLogSession/WorkoutLogEntry domain models
tasks.dod: Unit tests confirm the domain types capture session_day/started_at/ended_at/end_reason and reps/sets/weight/dict_exercise_id exactly as data-model.md defines, with no persistence concerns leaking in.

tasks.title: Build workoutLogRepository for session + entry CRUD
tasks.dod: Integration tests cover findActiveByChatOrClientId, startSession, closeSession(end_reason), and addEntry/countEntries against the promoted tables via the mapper boundary (row <-> domain).

tasks.title: Fix exerciseRepository.search to call search_dict_exercises
tasks.dod: Unit/integration test confirms search() issues search_dict_exercises(query, 0, 3) instead of the current inline SQL, returning 0-3 ranked rows, and the existing coach exercise-search API caller is unaffected in behavior beyond the corrected ranking.

tasks.title: Add OpenAI structured-output parse for exercise messages
tasks.dod: Unit tests (mocked OpenAI client) confirm the parser extracts exercise name/reps/sets/weight regardless of input language (AC-14) and returns an explicit unclear/incomplete result when reps, sets, weight-if-needed are missing or multiple exercises are described (AC-07/AC-08), per ADR-0001.

tasks.title: Build candidate-match confirmation payload
tasks.dod: Unit test confirms up to 3 candidates are returned each paired with the parsed numbers and a signed S3 image URL when the catalog exercise has one (text-only otherwise), and 0 candidates is surfaced as a distinct no-match outcome per AC-05b.

tasks.title: Handle initial exercise-description message
tasks.dod: Unit test confirms an exercise message is parsed (T6), matched (T7), and turned into a combined exercise+numbers confirmation prompt on success, or an unclear-message reply with one retry allowed (AC-07) on parse failure, replying in the client's stored language (AC-14) — and that nothing is written to workout_log_entry before confirmation.

tasks.title: Handle exercise confirmation response
tasks.dod: Unit test covers: confirming a candidate saves it linked, keeping own description or rejecting all candidates saves it unlinked (AC-06), rejecting the confirmed proposal triggers the same one-retry restate flow as AC-07 (AC-07b), and a retry that still fails to parse saves the original wording unconfirmed (AC-08).

tasks.title: Implement session start/end lifecycle
tasks.dod: Unit test covers: starting a session for a registered client opens one and sets session_day from local start time (AC-01/AC-13), a non-client is denied (AC-02), a repeat start is rejected without pre-empting the existing session (AC-12), and ending closes the session with end_reason=client-ended, distinguishing an empty session (AC-09b) from one with recorded entries (AC-09).

tasks.title: Wire workoutLoggingConversation into the conversation engine
tasks.dod: Integration test drives the WAITING_INPUT/WAITING_CONFIRMATION steps through the registered conversation type end to end (start -> describe -> confirm -> end), and a message sent with no open session gets the standard out-of-context reply (AC-04).

tasks.title: Wire cross-context pre-emption and lazy auto-expiry
tasks.dod: Integration test confirms an open workout-logging session is pre-empted (end_reason=pre-empted, unconfirmed entry discarded) when another route or a cron-enqueued reminder arrives for the same client (AC-10), and a session idle for more than 2h from its start or last entry is lazily closed (end_reason=auto-closed) on the next check (AC-11), per ADR-0003's existing expires_at mechanism.

tasks.title: Add QG-1/QG-3 integration test coverage
tasks.dod: Integration test suite asserts no workout_log_entry row exists before a confirmation action is processed for confirm/keep-own/reject branches (QG-1), and that a second startConversation of type workout-logging is blocked while one is active and pre-emption/expiry always leaves at most one active row per chat_id (QG-3).
